body.p: was riding the tusk of an elephant and fell asleep.

p.n: An Enemy Is Befriended in Times of Need
Young Cattle Only Nurse for a While

body.p:
Don’t you see that the offspring of animals follow them
hoping for their milk, but when it stops flowing they part from them

p.n: Clouds and Rain Come and Go

body.p:
Just as cloud form at a certain hour then disperse, appear once
and disappear the other,

so the state of the sensible man changes, as matters alter according to the diverse
characters of his companions: he can be open at times and reserved at others; trusting at times and again reserved
at others; pleased at times and cross at others.

p.n: Enmity Turns into Friendship in Times of Need

body.p:
And a person might break off some of what
had allied him to his friend without fearing any harm from him, because the basis of the affair had not been enmity; a person might also strike up a friendship
from enmity, out of a need that causes him to do so, and when the matter that brought this about goes away, that friendship turns
into enmity-
his case is like water heated with fire: when it is extinguished, the water becomes cold.

p.n: The Cat Is the Rat's Worst Enemy

body.p:
And no enmity is more harmful to me
than yours.

p.n: The Rat's Need for Friendship Has Gone

body.p:
You and Iwere compelled by a situation to create an agreement; but the matter
which made you need me, and which obliged me to you is over, and I fear that in its passing is
the revival of the enmity between me and you.

p.n: The Weak Must Avoid the Strong

body.p:
There is no good in the weak being close to the powerful enemy and no good
in the humble being near the grand.

p.n: The Cat Desires the Rat for Food

body.p: And I’m not aware that you need me in any way except your wanting to eat me,
so I don’t see that I should trust you;

p.n: The Cautious Weak Is Better Than Deluded Strong

body.p:
for I have learned that the weak person is closer to being safe from the strong,
when he is wary of him and not misled by him, than the powerful who feels safe while he is misled by the weak and trusts him.
